loading_policy.algorithm: Load at least the player cell and its eight neighbors (minimum 64m guaranteed reach). Configurable interest radius starts at 48m plus 16m safety margin; 96m plus margin is recommended when budget permits. Union selected cell dependency_owner_tiles once, not recursively. Stage all new owner terrain/native/box/contract colliders, then release old owners. Freeze movement while required owner data is pending or failed.
loading_policy.render_winding: terrain a,c,b with normals from a,b,c; common RenderData unchanged
loading_policy.collision_winding: terrain a,c,b; contract_triangles are already Godot clockwise and must not be flipped
loading_policy.exact_duplicate_policy: Apply render_skip_indices, collision_skip_indices, contract_collision_skip_indices from each tile companion
